name: deepseek-rate-card
note: Two readers, one card: the TypeScript lanes load this file through packages/eval/src/cost.ts and the tau2 driver loads it through eval/drivers/tau2/run_split.py. Both were hardcoded once and both were hardcoded separately, which is the arrangement in which one of them is eventually wrong. A test asserts the TypeScript constant matches this file, and a Python self-check asserts the driver's bill matches it too.
scheduling: A run scheduled inside a peak window pays exactly double, and a cron expression is a dispatch that nobody re-reads. The weekly regression run therefore starts at 18:00 UTC, which is outside the windows above and also outside the provider's published discount boundary, so the choice survives a correction to either one.
